why: User authorized architecture, backend, research and handoff with quality before time savings
result: In progress

decision: Selected a Django modular backend with generated frontend contracts
why: Shared transactional invariants and imported official data favor one domain owner; framework capabilities are reused
result: Implementation baseline committed at 4e56faa

decision: Installed pinned Codex workflows and original author packs
why: Requested mandatory Pstack and Fstack need explicit Codex routing and unchanged upstream identities
result: Original sources preserved; standalone REA verified; active client discovery remains session-specific

decision: Retained the modular Django backend after comparing Frappe and Payload structures
why: Official personnel facts stay in 1C while one transactional application owns portal requests, learning and knowledge
result: Implemented at 310ecbc; the comparison is structural and is not a benchmark of deployed alternatives

decision: Used one HRRequest aggregate with validated leave and advance field sets
why: Both kinds share the same workflow and transactional boundary; validation and database constraints reject mixed details
result: Implemented; separate LeaveDetails and AdvanceDetails tables from the early sketch were not required

decision: Preserved submitted revisions, assigned reviewers and chronological decisions
why: A returned request can change without rewriting the evidence of an earlier submission; role alone cannot authorize self-approval
result: Implemented with expected_version, idempotent commands, current scope checks and immutable submission evidence

decision: Committed request transitions, audit history, notifications and outbox records together
why: A partial approval or a provider call inside the approval transaction would leave inconsistent business evidence
result: Implemented; external delivery runs after the business transaction

decision: Imported normalized mock 1C batches under a legal-entity lock with revision and payload-hash checks
why: Concurrent partial hierarchy updates must not create a cycle; replay must not overwrite newer official facts
result: Implemented for existing provisioned employees; account provisioning and undocumented real 1C endpoints are not claimed

decision: Required explicit source confirmation and reversal of incorporated approved leave
why: A refreshed official balance must not subtract the same leave again; a Documentolog receipt is not accounting evidence
result: Implemented LeaveBalanceIncorporation with exact revision and days; later snapshots reaffirm inclusions or provide a reasoned reversal

decision: Separated provider acceptance, local acknowledgment and human approval
why: A crash after provider acceptance must recover with the same provider key without creating another document or changing the decision
result: Implemented stable receiver keys, skip-locked claims, expiring leases, fencing, retries and scoped operator recovery against the explicit mock provider

decision: Published validated immutable course snapshots and pinned enrollments to one version
why: Editing or archiving a course must preserve the material and assessment rules used for an earlier result
result: Implemented Course, CourseVersion, Enrollment, LessonCompletion and QuizAttempt with distinct state and ownership

decision: Kept progress commands under the learner and scoring under the server
why: A visible team record does not grant permission to complete it; published answer keys must not appear in learner responses
result: Implemented material prerequisites, attempt limits, server results and retained failure history; public synthetic seed keys are not a secure examination system

decision: Scoped retrieval before context construction and kept response modes explicit
why: A citation reference alone does not establish support for an arbitrary generated statement; unknown evidence requires refusal
result: Implemented extractive ranked excerpts and a configured source-bound selection strategy; live model quality remains unverified

decision: Built the home workbench as a read projection over existing modules
why: A second mutable task store would duplicate request, learning and case state; preview length must not replace the full count
result: Implemented own profile and learning, scoped review queues and current actions; computed_at does not mean a transactionally frozen cross-module snapshot

decision: Generated frontend types from serializers and marked immutable nested request evidence read-only
why: The independent frontend must not infer writable history or revisions from an incomplete schema
result: Schema and TypeScript reconciled at 310ecbc; actual permissions and business commands remain server-enforced

decision: Recorded the complete synthetic seed before any additive HTTP workflow probes
why: Fixture counts must describe an observed dataset; reruns and worker activity legitimately change live counts
result: Observed 58 employees, 2 entities, 30 courses, 60 lessons, 90 questions, 12702 material words, 189 enrollments and 94 attempts; no real personnel or policy data

decision: Separated module results, real HTTP assertions and the pending final combined suite
why: Adding counts from isolated module runs would double count shared tests; a native HTTP result does not prove Docker or rendered UI behavior
result: Two local workflow runs passed 807 assertions each; expected final 191-test PostgreSQL run, final publication and published-commit CI remain pending

decision: Delivered populated data, API states and professional-reference specifications to a separate frontend owner
why: The user assigned frontend, visual design and interaction implementation to the next agent while preserving the complete quality scope
result: Backend and specifications are implemented artifacts; no rendered JanaMen frontend or completed UX verification is claimed

decision: Replaced the deep seed fault join with bounded request and event UUID lookups
why: Fresh PostgreSQL planning must not stall the complete seed; fault assignment still belongs to the designated demo employee's approved requests
result: Implemented approved-request, approval-event and outbox lookups; the combined seed and rerun test uses a 10-second PostgreSQL statement timeout

decision: Closed the final combined backend gate using the persisted PostgreSQL report
why: A final shared run provides one unique suite total after module integration and seed correction
result: Passed 191 tests with zero failures, errors or skips in 145.92 seconds at f779305 on native PostgreSQL 16.15; final publication and published-commit CI remain pending
